title.zh: 卷二十一 本紀第二十一 徽宗三
title.raw: 卷二十一 本紀第二十一 徽宗三 Volume 21 Annals 21: Huizong 3

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲子，制：上書邪等人並不除監司。

translations.literal: Zhenghe year 2, spring, first month, day jiazi: a decree—those who had submitted heterodox memorials were not to be appointed circuit supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe 2, spring, jiazi: Huizong barred heterodox memorial-writers from circuit office.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子朔，蔡京復太師致仕，賜第京師。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuzi new moon: Cai Jing was restored as Grand Preceptor with permission to retire and was given a mansion in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuzi new moon: Cai Jing returned as Grand Preceptor in retirement and took a capital mansion.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以婉容崔氏為賢妃。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Graceful Beauty Cui was made Worthy Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Graceful Beauty Cui became Worthy Consort.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午朔，定國公栱薨。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuwu new moon: the Prince of Dingguo, Gong, died.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wuwu new moon: Prince of Dingguo Gong died.

sentences.zh: 己巳，禦集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Day jisi: at the Hall of Assembled Excellence the emperor examined jinshi candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Huizong examined jinshi at Jiaying Hall.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜禮部奏名進士及第、出身七百十三人。

translations.literal: Day jimao: seven hundred thirteen jinshi who had passed the Ministry of Rites examination were granted ranks of graduate and participant.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, seven hundred thirteen Ministry of Rites graduates took rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，詔縣令以十二事勸農於境內，躬行阡陌，程督勤惰。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jichou: an edict ordered magistrates to exhort farming within their counties on twelve matters, walk the fields themselves, and measure diligence and sloth.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jichou: magistrates were to preach twelve farming duties, walk the furrows, and reckon who worked.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，復行方田。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the equal-field system was reinstated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, equal-field law returned.

sentences.zh: 日中有黑子。

translations.literal: A black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A sunspot showed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，宴蔡京等於太清樓。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Cai Jing and others were feasted at Taiqing Tower.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Huizong feasted Cai Jing and the council at Taiqing Tower.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以定國軍節度使仲忽為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Zhong Hu, military commissioner of Dingguo Army, was made Grand Mentor with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Dingguo commissioner Zhong Hu took Kaifu with Three Excellencies ceremony.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以何執中為司空。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: He Zhizhong was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, He Zhizhong became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜張商英自便。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Zhang Shangying was granted leave at his pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Zhang Shangying was sent where he pleased.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，慮囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guihai: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guihai: the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，封子椿為慶國公。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: son Chun was enfeoffed Duke of Qingguo.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Chun became Duke of Qingguo.

sentences.zh: 己巳，蔡京落致仕，三日一至都堂議事。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Cai Jing relinquished retirement status; every three days he was to attend the capital council to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Cai Jing left retirement and came to the capital council every third day.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，以資政殿學士余深為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jichou: Yu Shen, Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, was made Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jichou: Yu Shen of the Hall for Assisting Governance took the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day yimao: a white rainbow spanned the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, a white rainbow cut the sun.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，訪天下遺書。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen: lost books throughout the realm were sought.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renshen: the court hunted lost books empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 丙子，置禮制局。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Bureau of Rites Regulation was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Bureau of Rites Regulation opened.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，改太尉以冠武階。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu: Grand Marshal was altered to head the military ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renwu: Grand Marshal was set above the military grades.

sentences.zh: 癸未，正三公、三孤官。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the offices of the Three Excellencies and Three Solitaries were rectified.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Three Excellencies and Three Solitaries were reordered.

sentences.zh: 改侍中為左輔，中書令為右弼，左、右僕射為太宰、少宰，罷尚書令。

translations.literal: Grand Counselor was changed to Left Assistant, Grand Secretary to Right Assistant, Left and Right Directors to Grand and Junior Ministers, and Minister-President was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Counselor became Left Assistant, Grand Secretary Right Assistant, both Directors Grand and Junior Minister, and Minister-President was struck.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，得玉圭於民間。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yisi: a jade tablet was obtained from among the people.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yisi: a jade tablet surfaced from the people.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，置知客省、引進、四方館、東西上閣門事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiwei: commissioners were placed for Guest Reception, Introducing, Four Directions Hall, and Eastern and Western Upper Palace Gate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiwei: guest, introducing, Four Directions, and upper gate commissioners were named.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，日南至，受元圭於大慶殿，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: winter solstice; the primal tablet was received at Daqing Hall and the empire was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, at winter solstice Huizong received the primal tablet in Daqing Hall and pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，蔡京進封魯國公。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Cai Jing was advanced to Duke of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Cai Jing became Duke of Lu.

sentences.zh: 以何執中為少傅、太宰兼門下侍郎，執政皆進秩。

translations.literal: He Zhizhong was made Junior Tutor, Grand Minister, and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery; all chief ministers were advanced in rank.
translations.idiomatic: He Zhizhong took Junior Tutor, Grand Minister, and the Chancellery; every chief minister rose a step.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，行給地牧馬法。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiashen: the law on granting land for pasturing horses was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiashen: the grant-land horse-pasture law took effect.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以鄭居中為特進。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Zheng Juzhong was made Special Advanced.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Zheng Juzhong was made Special Advanced.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以武信軍節度使童貫為太尉。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Tong Guan, military commissioner of Wuxin Army, was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wuxin commissioner Tong Guan became Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，定命婦名為九等。

translations.literal: Day yisi: titles for noble ladies were fixed in nine grades.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, noble ladies' titles were set in nine ranks.

sentences.zh: 丙午，燕輔臣于延福宮。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: chief ministers were banqueted at Yanfu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Huizong banqueted the council at Yanfu Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，封子楃為衛國公。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: son Mo was enfeoffed Duke of Weiguo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Mo became Duke of Weiguo.

sentences.zh: 是歲，成都府、蘇州火。

translations.literal: That year, Chengdu Superior Prefecture and Suzhou caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: That year fire took Chengdu and Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 出宮女三百八十三人。

translations.literal: Three hundred eighty-three palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred eighty-three palace women were sent out.

sentences.zh: 高麗入貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 成都路夷人董舜咨、董彥博內附，置祺、亨二州。

translations.literal: Yi of Chengdu circuit, Dong Shunzi and Dong Yanbo, submitted; Qi and Heng prefectures were established.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Shunzi and Dong Yanbo of Chengdu's Yi submitted; Qi and Heng prefectures were founded.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己未，以定王桓、嘉王楷並為太保。

translations.literal: Zhenghe year 3, spring, first month, day jiwei: the Prince of Ding, Wang Huan, and the Prince of Jia, Wang Kai, were both made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe 3, spring, jiwei: Princes of Ding and Jia, Huan and Kai, both became Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以廣平郡王構為檢校太保。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the Prince of Guangping commandery, Gou, was made acting Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Prince of Guangping Gou became acting Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔以天賜元圭，遣官冊告永裕、永泰陵。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: because Heaven had bestowed the primal tablet, officials were sent to announce it at the Yongyu and Yongtai mausolea.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Heaven's gift of the primal tablet was proclaimed at Yongyu and Yongtai tombs.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以燕王俁為太傅。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the Prince of Yan, Wang You, was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Prince of Yan Wang You became Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，追封王安石為舒王，子雱為臨川伯，配饗文宣王廟。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Wang Anshi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Shu; his son Pang was made Earl of Linchuan; they shared sacrifice at the temple of the Cultural Progenitor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wang Anshi was made posthumous Prince of Shu, Pang Earl of Linchuan, both enshrined with Confucius.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，吳居厚罷，以觀文殿學士鄭居中知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Wu Juhou was dismissed; Zheng Juzhong, Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Wu Juhou left office; Zheng Juzhong of Viewing Literature took Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以越王偲為太傅，封子楗為韓國公。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the Prince of Yue, Wang Si, was made Grand Tutor; son Jian was enfeoffed Duke of Hanguo.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Prince of Yue Wang Si became Grand Tutor and Jian Duke of Hanguo.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，以德妃王氏為淑妃。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiashen: Virtuous Consort Wang was made Gracious Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiashen: Virtuous Consort Wang became Gracious Consort.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，罷文臣勳官。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: merit ranks for civil officials were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, civil merit ranks ended.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，崇恩太后暴崩。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Empress Dowager Chong'en died suddenly.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Empress Dowager Chong'en died without warning.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以遼、女真相持，詔河北治邊防。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: because Liao and the Jurchen were locked in struggle, Hebei was ordered to ready the border defenses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, with Liao and Jurchen at grips, Hebei was told to brace the frontier.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔百官奉祠祿者並以三年為任。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: an edict—officials holding temple stipends were all to serve three-year terms.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, temple-stipend officers were fixed to three-year terms.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，增定六朝勳臣一百一十六人。

translations.literal: Day yisi: one hundred sixteen meritorious ministers of the Six Dynasties period were added to the roster.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the roster gained one hundred sixteen Six Dynasties merit ministers.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, day renzi new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renzi new moon: the sun was eaten.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，進神宗淑妃宋氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Pure Consort Song of Emperor Shenzong was advanced to Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Shenzong's Pure Consort Song became Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 升永安縣為永安軍。

translations.literal: Yong'an county was elevated to Yong'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: Yong'an county became Yong'an Army.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賜上舍生十九人及第。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: nineteen upper-academy students were granted the jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, nineteen upper-academy men took jinshi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，作保和殿。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi: Baohe Hall was built.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuzi: Baohe Hall rose.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以復溱、播，等州降德音于梓夔路。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: because Qin, Bo, and other prefectures were recovered, a grace decree was issued in Zi-Cui circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, recovery of Qin, Bo, and the rest won a grace decree in Zi-Cui.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，鄧洵仁罷。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Deng Xunren was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Deng Xunren left office.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以福寧殿東建玉清和陽宮。

translations.literal: Day yisi: east of Funing Hall, Jade Clarity and Harmony Yang Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Jade Clarity and Harmony Yang Palace went up east of Funing Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙午，升定州為中山府。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Ding prefecture was elevated to Zhongshan Superior Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Ding became Zhongshan Superior Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以資政殿學士薛昂為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Xue Ang, Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Xue Ang of Assisting Governance became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，班《五禮新儀》。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the New Rites in Five Categories was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the New Rites in Five Categories went out.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙辰，改公主為帝姬。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day bingchen: princesses were renamed Imperial Daughters.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, bingchen: princesses became Imperial Daughters.

sentences.zh: 戊午，復置醫學。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: medical studies were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the medical school reopened.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上崇恩太后諡曰昭懷。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Empress Dowager Chong'en was given the posthumous title Zhaohuai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Chong'en was titled Zhaohuai posthumously.

sentences.zh: 庚午，慶國公椿薨。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Duke of Qingguo Chun died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Duke of Qingguo Chun died.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，慮囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiyou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yiyou: the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丙申，升蘇州為平江府。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Suzhou was elevated to Pingjiang Superior Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Suzhou became Pingjiang Superior Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大盈倉火。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the Great Surplus granary caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the Great Surplus granary burned.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以築溱、播進執政官一等。

translations.literal: Day renyin: because Qin and Bo were fortified, chief ministers were advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, fortifying Qin and Bo raised every chief minister one rank.

sentences.zh: 丙午，葬昭懷皇后于永泰陵。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Empress Zhaohuai was buried at Yongtai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Empress Zhaohuai went to Yongtai tomb.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔尚書內省分六司，以掌外省六曹所上之事；

translations.literal: Day dingwei: an edict divided the Inner Secretariat of the Department of State Affairs into six bureaus to handle matters submitted by the six ministries of the outer secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Inner Secretariat split into six bureaus for the outer six ministries' business;

sentences.zh: 置內宰、副宰、內史、治中等官及都事以下吏員。

translations.literal: inner chief, deputy chief, inner secretary, directors, and clerks through chief clerks were established.
translations.idiomatic: inner chief, deputy, secretary, directors, and clerks down to chief clerks were named.

sentences.zh: 己酉，班新燕樂。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the new banquet music was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the new banquet music was issued.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，祔昭懷皇后神主于太廟。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai: Empress Zhaohuai's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guihai: Zhaohuai's tablet entered the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，降兩京、河陽、鄭州囚罪一等，民緣園陵役者蠲其賦。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: prisoners in the Two Capitals, Heyang, and Zheng prefecture had sentences reduced one degree; people serving on mausoleum corvée had levies remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Two Capitals, Heyang, and Zheng prisoners won one degree of mercy; mausoleum corvée levies were waived.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，升趙城縣為慶祚軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiwei: Zhaocheng county was elevated to Qingzuo Army.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guiwei: Zhaocheng became Qingzuo Army.

sentences.zh: 甲申，還王珪、孫固贈諡，追復韓忠彥、曾布、安燾、李清臣、黃履等官職。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: posthumous titles were restored to Wang Gui and Sun Gu; offices were posthumously restored to Han Zhongyan, Zeng Bu, An Tao, Li Qingchen, Huang Lü, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Wang Gui and Sun Gu regained posthumous titles; Han Zhongyan, Zeng Bu, An Tao, Li Qingchen, Huang Lü, and others regained office.

sentences.zh: 庚子，貴妃劉氏薨。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Noble Consort Liu died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Noble Consort Liu died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，復置白州。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Bo prefecture was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Bo prefecture returned.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，以燕樂成，進執政官一等。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: because the banquet music was complete, chief ministers were advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiaxu: finished banquet music raised the council one rank.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以何執中為少師。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: He Zhizhong was made Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, He Zhizhong became Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，升潤州為鎮江府。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Run prefecture was elevated to Zhenjiang Superior Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Run became Zhenjiang Superior Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，封四鎮山為王。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the mountains of the four circuits were enfeoffed as kings.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the four circuit sacred peaks were titled kings.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，詔大理寺、開封府不得奏獄空，其推恩支賜並罷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: an edict—forbade the Court of Judicial Review and Kaifeng prefecture to report empty prisons; the grace gifts for doing so were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengyin: Justice and Kaifeng could no longer boast empty jails; the rewards for it ended.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，追冊貴妃劉氏為皇后，諡曰明達。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Noble Consort Liu was posthumously enfeoffed as empress with the title Mingda.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Noble Consort Liu was made empress posthumously as Mingda.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，閱新樂器於崇政殿，出古器以示百官。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yichou: new musical instruments were inspected at Chongzheng Hall; ancient vessels were displayed for the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yichou: Huizong reviewed new instruments at Chongzheng and showed antiquities to the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔冬祀大禮及朝景靈宮，並以道士百人執威儀前導。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: an edict—at the winter great sacrifice and audiences at Jingling Palace, a hundred Daoist masters were to lead with ritual insignia.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, winter rites and Jingling audiences were to be led by a hundred Daoist masters bearing insignia.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛巳，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day xinsi: Jingling Palace was visited in offering.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinsi: Huizong offered at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，饗太廟，加上神宗諡曰體元顯道法古立憲帝德王功英文烈武欽仁聖孝皇帝，改上哲宗諡曰憲元繼道世德揚功欽文睿武齊聖昭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Imperial Temple was feasted; Emperor Shenzong's posthumous title was extended to Emperor Tiyuan Xiandao Fagu Lixian Dide Wanggong Yingwen Liewu Qinren Shengsiao; Emperor Zhezong's was changed to Emperor Xianyuan Jidao Shide Yanggong Qinwen Ruiwu Qisheng Zhaoxiao.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Imperial Temple was feasted; Shenzong's posthumous name was lengthened and Zhezong's retitled.

sentences.zh: 癸未，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the Lord on High was sacrificed to at the Round Mound; great amnesty for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Huizong sacrificed to Heaven at the Round Mound and pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 升端州為興慶府。

translations.literal: Duan prefecture was elevated to Xingqing Superior Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Duan became Xingqing Superior Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以天神降，詔告在位，作《天真降臨示現記》。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: because a celestial spirit had descended, those in office were notified and A Record of the True Heaven's Descent and Manifestation was composed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, a spirit's descent was announced to the court and A Record of True Heaven's Manifestation was written.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以賢妃崔氏為德妃。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Worthy Consort Cui was made Virtuous Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Worthy Consort Cui became Virtuous Consort.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，築祥州。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Xiang prefecture was fortified.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Xiang prefecture was walled.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔有官人許舉八行。

translations.literal: Day jihai: an edict—officeholders might nominate men of the Eight Conducts.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, officeholders were allowed to present men of the Eight Conducts.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，詔天下訪求道教仙經。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guichou: an edict—Daoist immortal scriptures were sought throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guichou: the empire was told to seek Daoist immortal scriptures.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔天下貢醫士。

translations.literal: Day yimao: an edict—physicians were to be sent as tribute from throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, physicians were summoned as tribute from every circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Venus was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江東旱，溫、封、滋三州火。

translations.literal: That year, Jiangdong suffered drought; Wen, Feng, and Zi prefectures caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jiangdong dried; Wen, Feng, and Zi burned.

sentences.zh: 出宮女二百七十有九人。

translations.literal: Two hundred and seventy-nine palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred and seventy-nine palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月戊寅朔，置道階凡二十六等。

translations.literal: Year 4, spring, first month, day wuyin new moon: Dao ranks were established, twenty-six grades in all.
translations.idiomatic: Year 4, spring, wuyin new moon: twenty-six grades of Dao rank were established.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，追封濮王子宗誼為祁王，宗詠為萊王，宗師為溫王，宗輔為楚王，宗博為蕭王，宗沔為霍王，宗藎為建王，宗勝為袁王。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: posthumous enfeoffment was granted to Prince of Pu’s sons Zongyi as Prince of Qi, Zongyong as Prince of Lai, Zongshi as Prince of Wen, Zongfu as Prince of Chu, Zongbo as Prince of Xiao, Zongmian as Prince of Huo, Zongjin as Prince of Jian, and Zongsheng as Prince of Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, eight sons of the Prince of Pu received posthumous princely titles from Qi to Yuan.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，賜上舍生十七人及第。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingsi: seventeen Upper College students were granted passage.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dingsi: seventeen Upper College students passed the examination.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，改淯井監為長寧軍。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Yujing Circuit was changed to Changning Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Yujing Circuit became Changning Army.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，長子桓冠。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the eldest son Huan came of age.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the eldest son Huan came of age.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子朔，以淑妃王氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingzi new moon: Gentle Consort Lady Wang was made Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingzi new moon: Gentle Consort Wang became Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，幸尚書省，以手詔訓誡蔡京、何執中，各官遷秩，吏賜帛有差。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengxu: the emperor visited the Secretariat; by handwritten edict he admonished Cai Jing and He Zhizhong; each was advanced in rank and clerks were given silk in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengxu: at the Secretariat he admonished Cai Jing and He Zhizhong by autograph, advanced their ranks, and gave clerks graded gifts of silk.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，閱太學、辟雍諸生雅樂。

translations.literal: Day guichou: court music of the Grand Academy and Imperial Academy students was reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Grand Academy and Imperial Academy students performed court music for review.

sentences.zh: 甲子，改戎州為敘州。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Rong prefecture was changed to Xu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Rong prefecture became Xu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，始祭地于方澤，以太祖配。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingxu: earth sacrifice at the Square Mound began, with Taizu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingxu: earth rites at the Square Mound began, with Taizu as associate.

sentences.zh: 降德音於天下。

translations.literal: A grace edict was issued throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: A grace edict went out empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 子機薨。

translations.literal: The son Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: The son Ji died.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，慮囚。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuwu: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuwu: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以廣西溪洞地置隆、兌二州。

translations.literal: Day renshen: from Guangxi stream-cave lands the two prefectures Long and Dui were established.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Guangxi stream-cave lands became Long and Dui prefectures.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，置保壽粹和館，以養宮人有疾者。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingchou: the Baoshou Cuihe Lodge was established to care for palace women who were ill.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingchou: Baoshou Cuihe Lodge opened for sick palace women.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，焚苑東門所儲毒藥可以殺人者，仍禁勿得復貢。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: poisons stored at the eastern park gate that could kill people were burned, and tribute of them was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, lethal poisons at the eastern park gate were burned and further tribute banned.

sentences.zh: 甲午，祔明達皇后神主于別廟。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the spirit tablet of Empress Mingda was enshrined in a separate temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Empress Mingda’s spirit tablet entered a separate temple.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，改端明殿學士為延康殿學士，樞密直學士為述古殿直學士。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yisi: Duanming Hall academician was changed to Yankang Hall academician; Bureau of Military Affairs direct academician was changed to Shugu Hall direct academician.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yisi: Duanming academicians became Yankang academicians and Military Affairs direct academicians Shugu direct academicians.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，定武臣橫班以五十員為額。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the lateral military roster was fixed at fifty posts.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the lateral military roster was capped at fifty posts.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，以安靜軍節度使王憲為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yimao: Anjing Army military commissioner Wang Xian was made Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yimao: Wang Xian of Anjing Army became Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔諸路兵應役京師者，並以十月朔遣歸。

translations.literal: Day jihai: an edict ordered troops from every circuit on corvée at the capital to be sent home on the first day of the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, circuit troops on capital corvée were ordered home by the tenth month’s first day.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，復置拱州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yisi: Gong prefecture was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yisi: Gong prefecture was restored.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，封子梴為相國公。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingchou: the son Chan was enfeoffed Duke of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingchou: the son Chan was enfeoffed Duke of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，以禁中神禦殿成，減天下囚罪一等。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiyou: because the inner-palace Divine Defense Hall was completed, prisoners’ crimes empire-wide were reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiyou: completion of the Divine Defense Hall cut empire-wide sentences one degree.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，定朝議、奉直大夫以八十員為額。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Court Gentleman for Discussion and Court Gentleman for Direct Service were fixed at eighty posts each.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Court Gentleman for Discussion and Direct Service were each capped at eighty posts.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔廣南市舶司歲貢真珠、犀角、象齒。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: an edict ordered the Guangnan Maritime Trade Office to present pearls, rhinoceros horn, and ivory yearly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Guangnan’s maritime trade office was ordered to present pearls, rhinoceros horn, and ivory yearly.

sentences.zh: 是歲，相州野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: That year wild silkworms in Xiang prefecture formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: That year Xiang prefecture reported wild silkworms forming cocoons.

sentences.zh: 出宮女六十八人。

translations.literal: Sixty-eight palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty-eight palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月庚辰，瀘南晏州夷反，尋詔梓州路轉運使趙遹等督兵討平之。

translations.literal: Year 5, spring, first month, day gengchen: Luzhou Yanzhou Yi rebelled; soon an edict ordered Zizhou circuit transport commissioner Zhao Yu and others to supervise troops and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Year 5, spring, gengchen: Luzhou Yanzhou Yi rose; Zhao Yu and others were ordered to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 己丑，令諸州縣置醫學，立貢額。

translations.literal: Day jichou: every prefecture and county was ordered to establish medical schools and set quota places.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, every prefecture and county was told to open medical schools with quota places.

sentences.zh: 甲午，改龍州為政州。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Long prefecture was changed to Zheng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Long prefecture became Zheng prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，立定王桓為皇太子。

translations.literal: Second month, day yisi: Prince of Ding Huan was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yisi: Prince of Ding Huan was made heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，冊皇太子，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the heir apparent was invested; the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the heir apparent was invested and the realm pardoned.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以童貫領六路邊事。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Tong Guan was put in charge of the six-circuit frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Tong Guan took the six-circuit frontier command.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinwei new moon: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinwei new moon: Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 己卯，禦集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the emperor held the palace examination at Hall of Assembled Elegance.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the palace examination was held at the Hall of Assembled Elegance.

sentences.zh: 甲申，追論至和、嘉祐定策功，封韓琦為魏郡王，復文彥博官。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: merit in settling the Zhihe and Jiayou succession was reviewed; Han Qi was enfeoffed Prince of Wei commandery and Wen Yanbo’s office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zhihe and Jiayou succession merit was reviewed; Han Qi became Prince of Wei and Wen Yanbo was restored.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔以立皇太子，見責降文武臣僚並與牽復甄敘，凡千五百人。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: because the heir apparent was established, all civil and military officials then demoted or censured were to be restored and ranked; in all one thousand five hundred persons.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, establishing the heir restored fifteen hundred demoted civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，升舒州為德慶軍。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Shu prefecture was promoted to Deqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Shu prefecture became Deqing Army.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賜禮部奏名進士出身六百七十人。

translations.literal: Day guisi: six hundred and seventy men who had passed the Ministry of Rites examination were granted jinshi origin.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, six hundred and seventy Ministry of Rites examinees received jinshi origin.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，作葆真宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiachen: Baozhen Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiachen: Baozhen Palace was built.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詣景靈宮，還，幸秘書省，進館職官一等。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: he went to Jingling Palace; returning, he visited the Secretariat and advanced academy posts one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, after Jingling Palace he visited the Secretariat and raised academy posts one grade.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，改集英殿為右文殿。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Hall of Assembled Elegance was changed to Hall of Right Culture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the Hall of Assembled Elegance became the Hall of Right Culture.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，置宣和殿學士。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Xuanhe Hall academicians were established.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Xuanhe Hall academicians were established.

sentences.zh: 詔東宮講讀官罷讀史。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Eastern Palace lecture officials to cease reading history.
translations.idiomatic: Lecture officials of the Eastern Palace were ordered to stop reading history.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，慮囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renchen: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renchen: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，以修三山河橋，降德音于河北、京東、京西路。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guichou: because the Sanhe River bridge was being repaired, a grace edict was issued in Hebei, Jingdong, and Jingxi circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guichou: bridge work on the Sanhe brought a grace edict in Hebei, Jingdong, and Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuchen new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuchen new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，升汝州為陸海軍。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Ru prefecture was promoted to Luhai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Ru prefecture became Luhai Army.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔建明堂於寢殿之南。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict ordered the Bright Hall built south of the sleeping quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Bright Hall was ordered built south of the sleeping quarters.

sentences.zh: 甲申，昭慶軍節度使蔡卞為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Zhaoging Army military commissioner Cai Bian was made Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Cai Bian of Zhaoging Army became Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，封子樾為瀛國公。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the son Yue was enfeoffed Duke of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the son Yue was enfeoffed Duke of Ying.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以秘書省地為明堂。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: Secretariat lands were taken for the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiyou: Secretariat land was set aside for the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，升通利軍為濬州、平川軍節度。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Tongli Army was promoted to Jun prefecture and Pingchuan Army command.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Tongli Army became Jun prefecture and Pingchuan Army command.

sentences.zh: 嗣濮王仲增薨。

translations.literal: Heir of the Prince of Pu Zhongzeng died.
translations.idiomatic: Heir of the Prince of Pu Zhongzeng died.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，封仲禦為嗣濮王。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jimao: Zhongyu was enfeoffed Heir of the Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jimao: Zhongyu became Heir of the Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，封子楧為惠國公。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the son Huan was enfeoffed Duke of Hui.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the son Huan was enfeoffed Duke of Hui.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，以嵩山道人王仔昔為沖隱處士。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao: Songshan Daoist Wang Zaixi was made Recluse of Hidden Transcendence.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guimao: Wang Zaixi of Songshan became Recluse of Hidden Transcendence.

sentences.zh: 戊午，夏國入貢。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Western Xia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Western Xia brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，錄昭憲皇后杜氏之裔。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guiyou: descendants of Empress Zhaoxian of the Du clan were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guiyou: descendants of Empress Zhaoxian Du were registered.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，高麗遣子弟入學。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Koryo sent sons to study at the academy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Koryo sent sons to study at the academy.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，升遂州為遂寧府。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai: Sui prefecture was promoted to Suining prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jihai: Sui prefecture became Suining prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以平晏夷，曲赦四川。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: because the Yanzhou Yi were pacified, a partial amnesty was granted in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, pacifying the Yanzhou Yi brought a partial amnesty in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，置緣邊安撫司於瀘州。

translations.literal: Day guihai: a frontier pacification office was established at Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, a frontier pacification office was established at Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，平江府、常、湖、秀州水。

translations.literal: That year Pingjiang prefecture and Chang, Hu, and Xiu prefectures had floods.
translations.idiomatic: That year Pingjiang and Chang, Hu, and Xiu prefectures flooded.

sentences.zh: 出宮女五十人。

translations.literal: Fifty palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月戊子，以瀘南獻捷，轉宰執一官。

translations.literal: Year 6, spring, first month, day wuzi: because Luzhou presented a victory, the chief ministers were advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Year 6, spring, wuzi: a Luzhou victory raised the chief ministers one rank.

sentences.zh: 以童貫宣撫陝西、河北。

translations.literal: Tong Guan was made pacification commissioner of Shaanxi and Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Guan became pacification commissioner of Shaanxi and Hebei.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬寅，升潁州為順昌府。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day renyin: Ying prefecture was promoted to Shunchang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, renyin: Ying prefecture became Shunchang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，置道學。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Dao learning was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Dao learning was established.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，詔增廣天下學舍。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: an edict ordered school buildings expanded empire-wide.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dinghai: school buildings were ordered expanded empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔廣京城。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: an edict ordered the capital city expanded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the capital expansion was ordered.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，賜上舍生十一人及第。

translations.literal: Third month, day guichou: eleven Upper College students were granted passage.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guichou: eleven Upper College students passed the examination.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，會道士于上清寶籙宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yichou: Daoists were assembled at the Upper Pure Talisman Treasure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, yichou: Daoists assembled at the Upper Pure Talisman Treasure Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以何執中為太傅致仕，朝朔望。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: He Zhizhong was made Grand Preceptor and retired, attending court on the first and fifteenth.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, He Zhizhong retired as Grand Preceptor but attended on new and full moons.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔天甯諸節及壬戌日，杖已下罪聽贖。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict allowed redemption for crimes below the rod on all Tianning festival days and on renxu days.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Tianning festivals and renxu days allowed redemption below the rod.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，卻監司、守臣進獻。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: presents from circuit supervisors and prefects were refused.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, presents from circuit supervisors and prefects were refused.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔蔡京三日一朝，正公相位，總治三省事。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: an edict ordered Cai Jing to attend court every three days, restored to full chief-minister standing, and to oversee all Three Departments affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Cai Jing was told to attend every three days, restored as chief minister, and to run all Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，廢錫錢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingyou: tin coin was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingyou: tin coin was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以鄭居中為少保、太宰兼門下侍郎，劉正夫為特進、少宰兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Zheng Juzhong was made Junior Guardian, Grand Chancellor, and Vice Director of the Chancellery; Liu Zhengfu was made Special Advanced, Junior Chancellor, and Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zheng Juzhong became junior guardian and chancellery vice director; Liu Zhengfu became special advanced and secretariat vice director.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以保大軍節度使鄧洵武知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Baoda Army military commissioner Deng Xunwu was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Deng Xunwu of Baoda Army became director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，班中書官制格。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingyin: the Secretariat office regulations were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingyin: Secretariat office regulations were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 庚午，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengwu: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔堂吏遷官至奉直大夫止。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: an edict ordered that Chancellery clerks might rise only to Court Gentleman for Direct Service.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Chancellery clerks were capped at Court Gentleman for Direct Service.

sentences.zh: 癸未，皇太子納妃朱氏。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the heir apparent took Lady Zhu as consort.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the heir apparent married Lady Zhu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰朔，以震武城為震武軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renchen new moon: Zhenwu city was made Zhenwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renchen new moon: Zhenwu city became Zhenwu Army.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以德妃崔氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Virtuous Consort Lady Cui was made Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Virtuous Consort Cui became Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以河陽三城節度使王薦為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Heyang Three Cities military commissioner Wang Jian was made Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Wang Jian of Heyang Three Cities became Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 諸盜晏州卜漏

translations.literal: The various bandits: Bolou of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The various bandits included Bolou of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: (闕一字)

translations.literal: (One character missing.)
translations.idiomatic: (One character missing in the source.)

sentences.zh: 、沅州黃安俊、定邊軍李吪𠼪熔墨騆搳A詔函首於甲庫。

translations.literal: , Huang Anjun of Yuanzhou, Li Ao of Dingbian Army [text corrupt in source]; an edict ordered their heads boxed and stored in the armory.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Anjun of Yuanzhou and Li Ao of Dingbian Army were among them; an edict ordered their heads boxed in the armory.

sentences.zh: 壬子，曲赦湖北。

translations.literal: Day renzi: a partial amnesty was granted in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Hubei received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己未，解池生紅鹽。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: red salt formed at the Jiechi salt works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, red salt formed at the Jiechi salt works.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，改走馬承受公事為廉訪使者。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the office of traveling horse commissioner was changed to Investigation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, traveling horse commissioners became Investigation Commissioners.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌朔，戒北邊帥臣毋生事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renxu new moon: northern frontier commanders were warned not to provoke incidents.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renxu new moon: northern commanders were warned against provocation.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔天下監司、郡守搜訪岩穀之士，雖恢詭譎怪自晦者悉以名聞。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict ordered circuit supervisors and prefects empire-wide to search out recluses of cliff and valley—even the eccentric and self-concealing were all to be reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, every supervisor and prefect was told to name recluses, however eccentric or hidden.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸蔡京第。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the emperor visited Cai Jing’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the emperor visited Cai Jing’s residence.

sentences.zh: 己丑，升晉州為平陽、壽州為壽春、齊州為濟南府。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Jin prefecture was promoted to Pingyang, Shou prefecture to Shouchun, and Qi prefecture to Jinan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Jin became Pingyang, Shou became Shouchun, and Qi became Jinan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯朔，詣玉清和陽宮，上太上開天執符禦曆含真體道昊天玉皇上帝徽號寶冊。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinmao new moon: he went to the Jade Pure Harmony and Yang Palace and presented the honorific register and seals of the Supreme Lord, Opener of Heaven, Holder of Talismans, Ruler of the Calendar, Embodying Truth, Embodying the Way, Vast Heaven, Jade Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinmao new moon: at Jade Pure Harmony and Yang Palace he presented the Jade Emperor’s honorific register and seals.

sentences.zh: 丙申，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: an amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the empire was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 令洞天福地修建宮觀，塑造聖像。

translations.literal: An edict ordered grotto-heavens and blessed lands to build palaces and temples and cast sacred images.
translations.idiomatic: Grotto-heavens and blessed lands were ordered to build temples and cast sacred images.

sentences.zh: 以西內成，曲赦京西。

translations.literal: Because the Western Inner Palace was completed, a partial amnesty was granted in the western capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Completion of the Western Inner Palace brought a partial amnesty in the western capital region.

sentences.zh: 己未，以童貫為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Tong Guan was made Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Tong Guan became Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yichou: Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yichou: Venus showed by day.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月丁酉，于闐入貢。

translations.literal: Year 7, spring, first month, day dingyou: Khotan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Year 7, spring, dingyou: Khotan brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以殿前都指揮使高俅為太尉。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Palace Front Commander Gao Qiu was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Palace Front Commander Gao Qiu became Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，以大理國主段和譽為雲南節度使、大理國王。

translations.literal: Second month, day guihai: Dali king Duan Heyu was made Yunnan military commissioner and King of Dali.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guihai: Duan Heyu of Dali became Yunnan commissioner and King of Dali.

sentences.zh: 甲子，會道士二千余人於上清寶籙宮，詔通真先生林靈素諭以帝君降臨事。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: more than two thousand Daoist priests assembled at Shangqing Baolu Palace; Master of Penetrating Truth Lin Lingsu was ordered to explain the Sovereign Lord’s descent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, over two thousand Daoists met at Shangqing Baolu Palace and Lin Lingsu was told to explain the Sovereign Lord’s descent.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，禦集英殿策高麗進士。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: at the Hall of Assembled Elegance the emperor examined Goryeo jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Goryeo jinshi were examined at the Hall of Assembled Elegance.

sentences.zh: 辛未，改天甯萬壽觀為神霄玉清萬壽宮。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Tianning Wanshou Abbey was renamed Shenxiao Yuqing Wanshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Tianning Wanshou Abbey became Shenxiao Yuqing Wanshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸上清寶籙宮，命林靈素講道經。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the emperor visited Shangqing Baolu Palace and ordered Lin Lingsu to expound the Daoist canon.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, at Shangqing Baolu Palace Lin Lingsu was ordered to expound the Daoist canon.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，賜高麗祭器。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: ritual vessels were granted to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, gengyin: Goryeo received ritual vessels.

sentences.zh: 高麗進士權適等四人賜上舍及第。

translations.literal: Four Goryeo jinshi including Kwon Sik were granted Upper College passage.
translations.idiomatic: Four Goryeo jinshi, including Kwon Sik, passed the Upper College examination.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以童貫權領樞密院。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Tong Guan was made acting head of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Tong Guan acted as head of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙申，升鼎州為常德軍。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Ding prefecture was promoted to Changde Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Ding prefecture became Changde Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，帝諷道籙院上章，冊己為教主道君皇帝，止于教門章疏內用。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengshen: the emperor prompted the Daoist Registry to memorialize enfeoffing him as Sovereign Lord Emperor of the Teaching, limited to use within the teaching establishment’s documents.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengshen: the Daoist Registry was prompted to style him Teaching Sovereign Lord Emperor, only in teaching documents.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，升溫州為應道軍。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Wen prefecture was promoted to Yingdao Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Wen prefecture became Yingdao Army.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子朔，升慶州為慶陽軍、渭州為平涼軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuzi new moon: Qing prefecture was promoted to Qingyang Army and Wei prefecture to Pingliang Army.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuzi new moon: Qing became Qingyang Army and Wei became Pingliang Army.

sentences.zh: 己丑，如玉清和陽宮，上承天效法厚德光大後土皇地祇徽號寶冊。

translations.literal: Day jichou: at Jade Pure Harmony and Yang Palace he presented the honorific register and seals of the Imperial Earth Sovereign, Receiver of Heaven, Emulating the Law, Thick in Virtue, and Vast in Radiance.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, at Jade Pure Harmony and Yang Palace he presented the Imperial Earth Sovereign’s honorific register and seals.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命蔡攸提舉秘書省並左右街道籙院。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Cai You was ordered to supervise the Secretariat and the left and right street Daoist registries.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Cai You took the Secretariat and both street Daoist registries.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔權罷宮室修造。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict temporarily halted palace construction.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, palace construction was temporarily halted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祭地于方澤，降德音于諸路。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the earth was sacrificed at the Square Mound and gracious pronouncements were sent to all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, earth was sacrificed at the Square Mound and gracious edicts went to every circuit.

sentences.zh: 以監司州縣共為奸贓，令廉訪使者察奏，仍許民徑赴尚書省陳訴。

translations.literal: Because circuit supervisors and prefectural and county officials together committed corruption, Investigation Commissioners were to investigate and report, and commoners were permitted to appeal directly to the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Joint corruption by supervisors and local officials brought Investigation Commissioners and the right of direct appeal to the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，改玉清和陽宮為玉清神霄宮。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Jade Pure Harmony and Yang Palace was renamed Jade Pure Shenxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Jade Pure Harmony and Yang Palace became Jade Pure Shenxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，熙河、環慶、涇原地震。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renchen: Xinghe, Huancqing, and Jingyuan circuits were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renchen: Xinghe, Huancqing, and Jingyuan were shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔八寶增定命寶。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the eight treasures were ordered augmented with a Destiny Treasure.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the eight treasures gained a Destiny Treasure.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，詔明堂並祠五帝。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guihai: an edict ordered the Bright Hall to sacrifice jointly to the Five Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guihai: the Bright Hall was to sacrifice jointly to the Five Emperors.

sentences.zh: 鄭居中以母憂去位。

translations.literal: Zheng Juzhong left office on his mother’s mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Juzhong left office to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，詔湖北民力未紓，胡耳西道可罷進築。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi: an edict said Hubei’s labor strength was not eased and advance construction on the Huer West route might be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuzi: with Hubei still strained, advance work on the Huer West route might stop.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大饗明堂，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: a grand sacrifice was held at the Bright Hall and the realm was amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Bright Hall saw a grand sacrifice and the empire was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 乙未，劉正夫卒。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Liu Zhengfu died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Liu Zhengfu died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，西蕃王子益麻党征降，見於紫宸殿。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Tibetan prince Yimadangzheng surrendered and was received at Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Tibetan prince Yimadangzheng surrendered and was received at Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，進宰執官一等。

translations.literal: Day renyin: chief ministers were advanced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, chief ministers gained one grade.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以薛昂為特進。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Xue Ang was made extraordinary advance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Xue Ang became extraordinary advance.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，貴妃王氏薨。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Noble Consort Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Noble Consort Wang died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯朔，初禦明堂，班朔布政。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yimao new moon: the emperor first held court at the Bright Hall to proclaim the new moon and announce governance.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yimao new moon: he first held Bright Hall court to proclaim the new moon and announce policy.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，侯蒙罷。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Hou Meng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Hou Meng was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，命蔡京五日一赴都堂治事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengyin: Cai Jing was ordered to attend the chief council hall every five days to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengyin: Cai Jing was to attend the chief council every five days.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鄭居中起復。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Zheng Juzhong returned from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Zheng Juzhong returned from mourning.

sentences.zh: 以餘深為特進、少宰兼中書侍郎，白時中為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Yu Shen was made extraordinary advance, junior chief minister and concurrent vice director of the Secretariat; Bai Shizhong was made vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Shen became extraordinary advance and junior chief minister with Secretariat vice directorship; Bai Shizhong became Secretariat vice director.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，復置醴州。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Li prefecture was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Li prefecture was restored.

sentences.zh: 丙申，何執中卒。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: He Zhizhong died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, He Zhizhong died.

sentences.zh: 升石泉縣為軍。

translations.literal: Shiquan county was promoted to an army.
translations.idiomatic: Shiquan county became an army.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申朔，有星如月。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen new moon: a star appeared as large as the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wushen new moon: a star showed as large as the moon.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以薛昂為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Xue Ang was made vice director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Xue Ang became vice director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔天神降于坤寧殿，刻石以紀之。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: an edict said a celestial deity had descended at Kunning Palace; stone was carved to record it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, a celestial descent at Kunning Palace was recorded in stone.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以童貫領樞密院。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Tong Guan took charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Tong Guan headed Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 命戶部侍郎孟揆作萬歲山。

translations.literal: Households Vice Minister Meng Kui was ordered to build Mount Wansui.
translations.idiomatic: Vice minister of households Meng Kui was ordered to build Mount Wansui.

sentences.zh: 是歲，三山河水清。

translations.literal: That year the rivers of the Three Mountains ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Three Mountains rivers ran clear.

sentences.zh: 出宮女六十八人。

translations.literal: Sixty-eight palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty-eight palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 重和元年春正月甲申朔，受定命寶於大慶殿。

translations.literal: Chonghe year 1, spring, first month, day jiashen new moon: the Destiny Treasure was received at Daqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Chonghe 1, spring, jiashen new moon: the Destiny Treasure was received at Daqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊子，封孫諶為崇國公。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: grandson Chen was enfeoffed Duke of Chong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, grandson Chen was enfeoffed Duke of Chong.

sentences.zh: 己丑，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day jichou: an amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the empire was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 應元符末上書邪中等人，依無過人例。

translations.literal: Those who had memorialized heterodoxly at the end of Yuanfu were treated under the rule for the blameless.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfu-end heterodox memorialists were treated like the blameless.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，封侄有奕為和義郡王。

translations.literal: Day yisi: nephew Youyi was enfeoffed Prince of Heyi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, nephew Youyi became Prince of Heyi commandery.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以翰林學士承旨王黼為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Wang Fu was made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Hanlin chief Wang Fu became left vice director of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，增諸路酒價。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuchen: wine prices were raised in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuchen: wine prices rose in every circuit.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣武義大夫馬政由海道使女真，約夾攻遼。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Martial Righteousness Grandee Ma Zheng was sent by sea to the Jurchens to arrange a pincer attack on Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Ma Zheng went by sea to the Jurchens to plan a joint strike on Liao.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，升六安縣為六安軍。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Lu’an county was promoted to Lu’an Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Lu’an county became Lu’an Army.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔監司輒以禁錢買物為苞苴饋獻，論以大不恭。

translations.literal: An edict: circuit supervisors who used forbidden funds to buy goods for bribery and gifts were to be charged with great irreverence.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisors who spent forbidden funds on bribery gifts faced charges of great irreverence.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，詔監司、郡守自今須滿三歲乃得代，仍毋得通理。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingxu: an edict required circuit supervisors and prefects to complete three years before replacement, and terms might not be counted together.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingxu: supervisors and prefects now needed three full years before relief, without stacking terms.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，令嘉王楷赴廷對。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the Prince of Jia, Kai, was ordered to attend the palace examination.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Prince of Jia Kai was ordered to the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以茂州蕃族平，曲赦四川。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: because Maozhou tribes were pacified, a partial amnesty was granted in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, pacifying Maozhou tribes brought a partial amnesty in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，知建昌陳並等改建神霄宮不虔及科決道士，詔並勒停。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Jianchang prefect Chen Bing and others, for irreverent reconstruction of Shenxiao Palace and beating Daoist priests, were punished; Bing was ordered suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Chen Bing of Jianchang and others were punished for irreverent Shenxiao work and beating Daoists; Bing was suspended.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，禦集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: at the Hall of Assembled Elegance the emperor examined jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, jinshi were examined at the Hall of Assembled Elegance.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賜禮部奏名進士及第、出身七百八十三人。

translations.literal: Day wushen: seven hundred eighty-three jinshi listed by the Ministry of Rites were granted ranks of graduate and participant.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, seven hundred eighty-three Ministry of Rites graduates took rank.

sentences.zh: 有司以嘉王楷第一，帝不欲楷先多士，遂以王昂為榜首。

translations.literal: The authorities ranked the Prince of Jia, Kai, first; the emperor did not wish Kai ahead of all scholars, so Wang Ang was made top graduate.
translations.idiomatic: Officials ranked Kai first, but the emperor would not let him lead all scholars, so Wang Ang became top graduate.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑朔，築靖夏城、制戎城。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guichou new moon: Jingxia Fort and Zhira Fort were built.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guichou new moon: Jingxia Fort and Zhira Fort were built.

sentences.zh: 錄呂余慶後。

translations.literal: Descendants of Lü Yuqing were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of Lü Yuqing were registered.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，減捶刑。

translations.literal: Day guihai: flogging punishments were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, flogging punishments were eased.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔每歲以季秋親祠明堂，如孟月朝獻禮。

translations.literal: Day jimao: an edict ordered that each year in late autumn the emperor would personally sacrifice at the Bright Hall, as in the early-month morning offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, late-autumn personal Bright Hall sacrifice was ordered, matching the early-month morning rite.

sentences.zh: 乙太上混元上德皇帝二月十五日生辰為貞元節。

translations.literal: The birthday on the fifteenth day of the second month of the Great Supreme Mixed-Origin Upper Virtue Emperor was made Zhenyuan Festival.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Supreme Mixed-Origin Upper Virtue Emperor’s second-month fifteenth birthday became Zhenyuan Festival.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renwu new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renwu new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔諸路選漕臣一員，提舉本路神霄宮。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: each circuit was to select one transport commissioner to supervise that circuit’s Shenxiao palaces.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, each circuit was to assign one transport commissioner to its Shenxiao palaces.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以林靈素為通真達靈元妙先生，張虛白為通元沖妙先生。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Lin Lingsu was made Master of Penetrating Truth, Reaching Spirit, and Mysterious Wonder; Zhang Xubai was made Master of Penetrating Origin and Pristine Wonder.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Lin Lingsu became Master of Penetrating Truth, Reaching Spirit, and Mysterious Wonder; Zhang Xubai became Master of Penetrating Origin and Pristine Wonder.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，班禦制《聖濟經》。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the imperially composed Classic of Sacred Aid was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the imperial Classic of Sacred Aid was issued.

sentences.zh: 以青華帝君八月九日生辰為元成節。

translations.literal: The birthday on the ninth day of the eighth month of the Blue Flower Sovereign Lord was made Yuancheng Festival.
translations.idiomatic: The Blue Flower Sovereign Lord’s eighth-month ninth birthday became Yuancheng Festival.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，手敕兩浙漕司，以權添酒錢盡給御前工作。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: a personal edict to the Liang-Zhe transport office directed that surcharged wine tax funds all go to imperial front works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Liang-Zhe was told to send all surcharged wine money to imperial front works.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，以賢妃劉氏為淑妃。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yimao: Worthy Consort Liu was made Graceful Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yimao: Worthy Consort Liu became Graceful Consort.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以淮西盜平，曲赦。

translations.literal: Day jisi: because Huai River west bandits were pacified, a partial amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, pacifying Huai-west bandits brought a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚子，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以西邊獻捷，曲赦陝西、河東路。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: because the western army reported victory, a partial amnesty was granted in Shaanxi and Hedong circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, western victory brought a partial amnesty in Shaanxi and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，以西師有功，加蔡京恩，官其一子。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renwu: for western army merit Cai Jing received grace and one son was given office.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renwu: western merit brought Cai Jing grace and office for one son.

sentences.zh: 鄭居中為少傅，餘深為少保，鄧洵武為特進，進執政官一等。

translations.literal: Zheng Juzhong became junior tutor, Yu Shen junior guardian, and Deng Xunwu extraordinary advance; chief councillors were advanced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Juzhong became junior tutor, Yu Shen junior guardian, Deng Xunwu extraordinary advance, and councillors gained one grade.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遣廉訪使者六人振濟東南諸路水災。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: six Investigation Commissioners were sent to relieve flood disaster in southeast circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, six Investigation Commissioners went to relieve southeast floods.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，以童貫為太保。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiayin: Tong Guan was made grand guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiayin: Tong Guan became grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔班禦注《道德經》。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: an edict ordered the imperial commentary on the Dao De Jing promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the imperial Dao De Jing commentary was issued.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔執政非入謝及丐去，毋得獨留奏事。

translations.literal: Day renshen: an edict said chief councillors might not remain alone to memorialize except when entering to give thanks or requesting leave.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, councillors could not stay alone to memorialize except for thanks or leave requests.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封子椅為嘉國公。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the son Yi was enfeoffed Duke of Jia.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the son Yi was enfeoffed Duke of Jia.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，升兗州為襲慶府。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Yan prefecture was promoted to Xiqing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Yan prefecture became Xiqing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，大饗明堂。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinsi: a grand sacrifice was held at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinsi: the Bright Hall saw a grand sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔罷拘白地、禁榷貨、增方田稅、添酒價、取醋息、河北加折耗米、東南水災強糴等事。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict abolished seizure of vacant land, banned monopoly goods, increased square-field tax, added wine price, took vinegar interest, Hebei added loss allowance on rice, southeast flood forced purchase, and similar measures.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, vacant-land seizure, monopoly bans, square-field hikes, wine surcharges, vinegar profits, Hebei loss rice, and forced flood purchase were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔太學、辟雍各置《內經》、《道德經》、《莊子》、《列子》博士二員。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the National University and Imperial Academy each were to have two doctorate holders for the Inner Canon, Dao De Jing, Zhuangzi, and Liezi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the National University and Imperial Academy each gained two Daoist canon doctors.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以歲當戌、月當壬為元命，降德音於天下。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the year’s term being xu and the month’s term being ren were taken as primal destiny; gracious pronouncements were sent throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the xu year and ren month were styled primal destiny and gracious edicts went empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，薛昂罷。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Xue Ang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Xue Ang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以白時中為門下侍郎，王黼為中書侍郎，翰林學士承旨馮熙載為尚書左丞，刑部尚書范致虛為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Bai Shizhong was made vice director of the Chancellery, Wang Fu vice director of the Secretariat, Feng Xizai left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Fan Zhixu right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Shizhong became Chancellery vice director, Wang Fu Secretariat vice director, Feng Xizai left state-affairs vice director, and Fan Zhixu right vice director.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，禁州郡遏糴及邊將殺降以幸功賞者。

translations.literal: Day renchen: hoarding grain by prefectures and killing surrenderers for merit rewards by border generals were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, prefectural grain hoarding and killing surrenderers for merit were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，禁群臣朋黨。

translations.literal: Day guisi: factionalism among officials was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, official factions were banned.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，用蔡京言，集古今道教事為紀志，賜名《道史》。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: following Cai Jing’s proposal, Daoist affairs ancient and modern were collected into annals and records and titled History of the Way.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, at Cai Jing’s urging, Daoist records ancient and modern were compiled as the History of the Way.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，鄭居中罷，乞持餘服，詔從之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Zheng Juzhong was dismissed, asking to observe remaining mourning; the edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Zheng Juzhong was dismissed and allowed to finish mourning.

sentences.zh: 詔察縣令治行、諸路監司能改正州縣事者，較為殿最。

translations.literal: An edict ordered examination of magistrates’ conduct and comparison of circuit supervisors who could reform prefectural and county affairs for ranking.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates’ conduct was to be examined and reform-minded supervisors ranked against one another.

sentences.zh: 詔視中大夫林靈素、視中奉大夫張虛白並特授本品真官。

translations.literal: Lin Lingsu, treated as palace attendant, and Zhang Xubai, treated as court gentleman for attendance, were specially granted true posts at their nominal ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Lingsu and Zhang Xubai received true posts at their nominal attendant ranks.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚申，詔江、淮、荊、浙、閩、廣監司督責州縣還集流民。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day gengshen: Jiang, Huai, Jing, Zhe, Min, and Guang supervisors were to compel prefectures and counties to return and gather displaced persons.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, gengshen: six southeast circuits were to return and gather the displaced.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，進封楷為鄆王。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Kai was advanced to Prince of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Kai was advanced to Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔：周柴氏後已封崇義公，復立恭帝后以為宣義郎，監周陵廟，世世為國三恪。

translations.literal: An edict: a Zhou Chai clan descendant had already been enfeoffed Duke of Chongyi; the former empress was reestablished as Lang of Xuanyi to supervise Zhou imperial tombs, with perpetual three courtesies toward the state.
translations.idiomatic: The Chai heir already held Chongyi; the former Zhou empress was made Xuanyi lang to tend the Zhou tombs, with perpetual three courtesies.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jimao new moon: Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jimao new moon: Venus showed by day.

sentences.zh: 己亥，改興慶軍為肇慶府。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Xingqing Army was renamed Zhaoqing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Xingqing Army became Zhaoqing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，置道官二十六等，道職八等。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: twenty-six grades of Daoist offices and eight grades of Daoist ranks were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, twenty-six Daoist office grades and eight rank grades were set.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉朔，改元，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiyou new moon: the era name was changed and the realm was amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiyou new moon: the era name changed and the empire was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: a black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, a sunspot showed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以婉容王氏為賢妃。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Graceful Lady Wang was made Worthy Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Graceful Lady Wang became Worthy Consort.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，補上書人安堯臣官。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: heterodox memorialist An Yaochén was given office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, heterodox memorialist An Yaochén received office.

sentences.zh: 己巳，升梓州為潼川府。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Zi prefecture was promoted to Tongchuan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Zi prefecture became Tongchuan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅朔，復京西錢監。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuyin new moon: western capital coin offices were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuyin new moon: western capital coin offices were restored.

sentences.zh: 己丑，置裕民局。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the Bureau for Enriching the People was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the Bureau for Enriching the People was established.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江、淮、荊、浙、梓州水。

translations.literal: That year Jiang, Huai, Jing, Zhe, and Zi circuits suffered flood.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jiang, Huai, Jing, Zhe, and Zi circuits flooded.

sentences.zh: 出宮女百七十八人。

translations.literal: One hundred seventy-eight palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred seventy-eight palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 黃岩民妻一產四男子。

translations.literal: In Huangyan, a commoner’s wife bore four sons at one birth.
translations.idiomatic: At Huangyan a commoner’s wife bore four sons at once.

sentences.zh: 于闐、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: Khotan and Goryeo sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan and Goryeo brought tribute.
